notes.title: Beta 3.3 RunePower
notes.content:
You are the RuneChild, and now you have Rune Power... 
Select from 12 different powers, that grows as you use them.
Six offensive and six defensive powers.

Actually I ran out of line on the paper, so I just need to make an update... Before turn over the paper.

Added a load scene, when you enter new maps.
Added World Portal in the center of each map, so you can travel faster between maps.

Added Armour for the legs, and that you can take off the amour.
Added a compendium, where you can see Spells, Alchemy and Message Log.

Added a skill for the Rogue to find stuff, like containers, weapons Etc.
Change the colour of the Friendly summons and the enemies, so it is easier to see.

Icons on the top bar for NPC's and Servants, so it is easier to find them.
Added some trade mission, so you can earn money. (Yellow Balls over NPCs)

Cold damage now makes enemies move slower.
Slow-Mo now makes enemies moves slower, the strong the skill.
New spells for Enemies. Pin the Player, Enlarge the Enemy, and they upgrade after the player level.

notes.title: B3.2 Reward Cycle
notes.content:
Added a large dungeon system under the north trees on the elves map.
There is master Alchemy and Enchantment trainers with adv. tables in the west part.

Added a palace inside the Mountain for the elf king, with Elves guards.. (No king yet).
There is a master trader in the room to the left...
Added Master Traders in each map, with much more gold, so you can sell more items.

Added more armors and some adv. armor also have arms now.
Added a beginner help, so you have 5 StoneSkin, when you start with a new character.
Upgraded some spells that was not working.

Added login (streak) awards  and day awards.
Made my Reward Cycle easier to see.
Now you can see when you get XP or become better with a skill.
Added sounds to when you get Achievements and collect gold.

notes.title: B2.0 - Sword Crafting
notes.content:
Added that you can create your own sword. (75.000 swords combinations.)
Find an Anvil and Press C while touching it.

You can now fight the Hydra and the Balrog in the Fight Arena...
And you can select what enemy to fight on the three pillars.

Updated the way damage is taken by the player.
Change the attack patterns of the enemies, and added Boss Movies to the Boss fighters.
You can see which spell the enemy spell caster is casting.

Added three new dungeons on the AmberGate Map.
One is three levels deep, the others are two levels...
Added a simple marker that helps finding the exit points in the dungeons.

notes.title: Beta 1.9 Fight Patterns
notes.content:
Added a simple Fight Arena, that you can enter instead of starting the normal game.

Updating the enemy Boss Fight Patterns.
Most of The bosses have a extra attack pattern, like the Minotaur can make a Bull charge after you.
[url=https://youtu.be/dFnugtU7uck]YouTube: Minotaur Attack Pattern[/url]

Trolls boss use Camoflage and attacks with a poison bite, skeleton boss gives ice damage when attacking.

Now the enemy have different fight patterns, dependent on its type.
E.G. Normal Goblin just attacks, Goblin Boss attacks if you get to close to them, and  Goblin Shamans cast spells, and keep their distance....

The Medusa quest is ready in the AmberGate map, with two ways to complete the quest.

The Torch now gives Fire damage, but is still held in the left hand.
(You need fire to kill Trolls.)

Added player chest to the three maps.. (They are close to the middle of the map.)
Updating the Fight animations for the player.


The Fight Arena with nine Dragons...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997455/e7bcf1cc9593b0ad9ce114b98a2f8ea1360d681d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Beta 1.8 AmberGate 1
notes.content:
Started to update the AmberGate map.
Added fishes, plants, and spawn points.
Added two large new buildings, A pantheon and a Castle.
Added a large sewer complex beneath the city.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997455/ddb4c6ad629860c13ebddcf89ed560612340ecd5.jpg[/img]


Added a nature alter for the Stegosaurus... in Mossfield. 
(Pray at it and you get a Stegosaurus to ride on.)
Added small descriptions for building and places, mostly in the MossField Map.

Added +10 Achievements and some extra Stats for data. 

Now it counts distance for the character, and not the session.
(So if you have traveled long, saved and restarted the save game, the distance will be added up.)

Change a little in the skill menu, so now you can see all your known skills, at the start.
NPC's can be killed by the player, but it will effect your local Karma. 
Completing Quests added to your Local Karma.

The May month Challenge is 'Do as much Damage to an Enemy in one hit'.

notes.title: Simple Update for the Easter Egg Hunt
notes.content:
Just some simple things...
Added the Easter Egg Hunt, with 20 eggs, and a special price if you can complete it.

Change the way you get help.
Now you can press H in the different menus to see a little help message.
If you do in the game scene, you get the whole beginner help screen. 

I have change the order, how the list on the right side is made.
Now the 'News' is at the bottom, and goes up, so it is easier to see, what just happened.

notes.title: Update Beta 1.6, Options + Feedback
notes.content:
Added Gore, You can have Blood splatter when you hit an enemy.
Added WayPoints options, so you can remove icons, making it more of a Challenge to find things.
Added FastTravel Options, so you can limit how easy it is to travel.

Feedback things:
Added Stafe options, So you can change between Rotating and Moving sideways with A/D.
Added a break, so it is harder to run through walls.
Added a CheckSum, so you can't edit the Save Game file.
Added a small sound, when you pick up things, so you get audio feedback.
Added that you can also use Arrows and NumPad Arrows to move.
Change how the player touches things, so it is easier to interact with objects.
Expanded the Jump height to 150%, so it is easier to get up stairs.

Added two new mounts, you can ride.
A Stegosaurus, and a Bronze Dragon.
Change three potions, so now you get a random mount, monster or Element, when making those potions. 
(Make a +6 Str 'Conjure Mount' potions and you might get a bronze dragon... for a time.)

notes.title: Making a small patch for the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
This was just a minor update, for the steam next fest.

I have made trees with fruit and small Plow furrow with vegetables.
If you eat fruits or vegetables you heal a little, but they also gives you other health things.
Apples and Watermelons gives extra health, Citrus adds mana. Small amounts but...

The Orc towns has gotten orcs, and small fields outside them.
(No Quests in that map yet.)

You can sit and fish or sit a few places.
You can sleep in beds, and that will make you heal very fast.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997455/ed7043f83045f0e105d759cd8bafe18479710b5a.jpg[/img]
